caption: The drawing depicts a puppet-like figure centered on a blank, beige background. The figure has a human-shaped head with pale pink skin, red cheeks, dark eyebrows, black eyes with white sclera, and exaggerated red lips. The face is framed by curly, beige hair or lace, which also forms a ruffled edge around the face and neck. The puppet wears a loose, yellowish top with long sleeves, green trim at the bottom, and a green central panel on the chest area. Beige lace details run along the front edges and around the shoulders. The sleeves end in red fabric at the cuffs, and the hands, which appear to be made of a pinkish material, extend slightly outward. The figure’s lower half is covered by a long, voluminous black skirt that drapes down to the base. The composition is simple, with the figure occupying most of the page and no objects or details in the background.
title: Hand Puppet Judy
